Klasse MapData

java.lang.Object
org.golfit.shared.constants.MapData
public class MapData extends Object
Contains pre-computed map data for the server-side physics engine. Includes the terrain grid (SERVER_MAP), shape ID grid (SHAPE_ID_MAP), and the list of obstacle shapes (LEVEL_1_OBSTACLES) used for collision detection.
